# Catalog data (generated by `npm run catalog` from data/raw/, which is git-ignored)

| File | Contents | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| stars.json | 9,028 stars: mag ≤ 6.5 plus every named / constellation-line star (HIP, RA/Dec J2000, mag, B−V, name, Bayer/Flamsteed, constellation, spectral class) | HYG Database v4.1 (astronexus) | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| stars-faint.json | 32,488 stars mag 6.5–8.0, lazy-loaded when zoomed in | HYG v4.1 | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| constellations.json | 88 constellations: line figures (HIP ids), English + Latin names, IAU boundary segments; 660 star proper names merged into stars.json | Stellarium "modern" sky culture | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| dso.json | ~980 deep-sky objects: all 110 Messier + named + mag ≤ 11 (type, size, mag, constellation) | OpenNGC + addendum | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| dso-full.json | 12,160 NGC/IC/Caldwell/Barnard/etc. objects, lazy-loaded for id search | OpenNGC | CC BY-SA 4.0 |

Also vendored: `src/vendor/astronomy.browser.min.js` (astronomy-engine 2.1.19, MIT, Don Cross) and
`src/engine/geomag-coeffs.js` (NOAA/BGS World Magnetic Model 2025 coefficients, public domain).
| lightpollution.png | 1800×900 (0.2°) estimated Bortle class × 25 per pixel, baked in the browser from NASA Black Marble 2016 (light-spread model, calibrated on known sites) | NASA Earth Observatory | public domain (estimate, not a measurement) |
| darksites.json | 44 curated dark-sky destinations (USA + Bangladesh) with typical Bortle class | hand-curated from DarkSky International / park pages | CC0 (this project) |
